caption: Two people stretch a bungee cord, extending it to its maximum length.
old_relations: Hands grip cord ends, applying equal tension until maximum stretch occurs.
Cord’s elastic material resists elongation, storing potential energy under load.
Stretching force must exceed cord’s elastic limit to achieve maximum extension.
Cord remains taut and aligned during extension, maintaining uniform stress distribution.

proposed.semantic_focus: Two people pull opposite ends of a bungee cord, stretching it to its maximum extension.
relations: Opposing forces applied by the two people elongate the elastic cord.
The cord's tension increases as its length extends toward the limit.
